rules.canonical_name: 机器相邻工序大空档
rules.description: 在同一机器的相邻工序之间定位相对该机器典型加工时长显著偏大的空档。
rules.applicability_predicate: machine has at least two temporally ordered assignments
rules.measurement_definition: gap=end_to_next_start for every adjacent pair on each machine
rules.normalization: gap divided by robust median positive processing time on the same machine or comparable pool
rules.threshold_spec: tau_A1 is calibrated per family and instance scale; no universal constant is hard-coded

rules.canonical_name: 过载机器的主要负载贡献块
rules.description: 在可比较机器池内以容量和可用日历归一化负载，定位造成超额负载的连续工序段。
rules.applicability_predicate: at least two capacity-comparable resources exist in a declared machine pool
rules.measurement_definition: normalized busy load and excess contribution of contiguous assignments within each comparable pool
rules.normalization: busy duration divided by available capacity-time in the observation horizon
rules.threshold_spec: tau_A2 compares robust pool load deviation and minimum excess contribution

rules.canonical_name: 欠载机器的大空闲窗口
rules.description: 在可比较机器池中定位欠载机器上相对池内加工尺度显著偏长的可用空闲窗口。
rules.applicability_predicate: a comparable machine pool and usable calendar intervals are available
rules.measurement_definition: enumerate idle windows on underloaded machines and compare them with pool workload and processing scale
rules.normalization: idle duration divided by robust median processing time in the comparable pool
rules.threshold_spec: tau_A3 requires both underload deviation and a minimum normalized idle-window length

rules.canonical_name: 工件相邻工序停顿过长且传播至工期
rules.description: 定位同一工件相邻工序间显著偏长的等待，并要求后继工序对当前 makespan 具有传播相关性(M_j)：只有既明显又能扰动工期的等待才进入有效 A4。
rules.applicability_predicate: the job has at least one realized technological predecessor-successor pair
rules.measurement_definition: for each job precedence edge: wait=start(successor)-end(predecessor); WaitSeverity W_e=wait/(wait+p_scale) with p_scale=median realized duration; MakespanRelevance M_j of the successor = residual makespan perturbation reaching C_max over the realized DAG (1-D(o_j)/p_scale, D=shortest absorbable-gap path to a virtual sink); A4Score(e)=W_e*M_j
rules.normalization: W_e in [0,1) by p_scale saturation; M_j in [0,1] by absorbable-gap shortest path to C_max; A4Score in [0,1); block score=1-prod(1-A4Score(e)) bounded [0,1], no renormalization
rules.threshold_spec: discard edge when M_j<tau_M (perturbation cannot reach C_max) or A4Score(e)<tau_A4; only effective A4 edges aggregate into blocks

rules.canonical_name: 最后完工工件的拖尾后缀
rules.description: 定位接近 makespan 完成的工件，并提取其最后明显停顿之后或尾部窗口内的工艺后缀。
rules.applicability_predicate: schedule is complete and job completion times can be computed
rules.measurement_definition: identify jobs within the makespan tail band and extract their suffix from the last significant wait or tail cutoff
rules.normalization: completion slack and suffix span divided by makespan or robust job duration
rules.threshold_spec: tau_A5 defines the makespan tail band and significant-wait boundary

rules.canonical_name: 工序分配到明显较慢机器
rules.description: 仅对当前存在多个有效候选机器的工序，比较当前加工时长与有效候选中的最短加工时长。
rules.applicability_predicate: operation has at least two effective eligible machines in the current state
rules.measurement_definition: slowdown=current_processing_time/min_effective_processing_time
rules.normalization: dimensionless slowdown ratio and absolute excess duration
rules.threshold_spec: tau_A6 requires slowdown ratio or excess duration above calibrated limits

rules.canonical_name: 机器空闲时已有合格工序就绪
rules.description: 在机器空闲窗口中定位已满足前驱、释放和有效机器资格却仍未加工的工序。
rules.applicability_predicate: ready times and effective machine eligibility are available for an idle interval
rules.measurement_definition: overlap each usable machine idle window with intervals in which eligible operations are ready but unscheduled
rules.normalization: avoidable idle overlap divided by machine or pool processing-time scale
rules.threshold_spec: tau_A7 is a minimum normalized overlap and evidence-completeness gate

rules.canonical_name: 启用条件到达不同步
rules.description: 收集项目实际存在的工件、机器、释放、事件和辅助资源到达时刻，定位最大到达差。
rules.applicability_predicate: at least two independently computed enabling conditions apply to the operation
rules.measurement_definition: synchronization_gap=max(enablement_times)-min(enablement_times), retaining every binding source
rules.normalization: gap divided by operation or family processing-time scale
rules.threshold_spec: tau_A8 is calibrated by enablement type and only uses explicitly represented constraints

rules.canonical_name: 换型或任务切换碎片化
rules.description: 仅在存在明确换型族或序列相关准备时间时，定位高切换率和高准备时间占比的机器段。
rules.applicability_predicate: setup family or sequence-dependent setup semantics are explicitly available
rules.measurement_definition: compute family-switch rate, setup count and setup-time share over contiguous machine segments
rules.normalization: switches per transition and setup duration divided by segment elapsed time
rules.threshold_spec: tau_A9 requires elevated switching or setup-time share relative to comparable segments

rules.canonical_name: 动态事件后的明显偏移
rules.description: 在事件影响的残余问题内比较事件前参考计划和事件后计划，定位开始时间或机器分配显著变化的连通块。
rules.applicability_predicate: a dynamic event, pre-event reference schedule and post-event residual schedule are available
rules.measurement_definition: measure start-time displacement and machine-assignment changes for non-frozen residual operations, then form relation-connected components
rules.normalization: start displacement divided by local processing scale; assignment change remains categorical
rules.threshold_spec: tau_A10 combines event-scoped displacement and assignment-change gates

rules.canonical_name: 当前有效唯一机器
rules.description: 考虑故障、冻结、路线和绑定后，工序当前仅剩所用机器有效。
rules.applicability_predicate: effective machine set can be computed
rules.measurement_definition: cardinality(effective_machine_set)==1 and current machine is the member
rules.normalization: boolean
rules.threshold_spec: exact predicate

rules.canonical_name: 已就绪工序等待块占用机器
rules.description: 块占用机器期间，存在其他已就绪且允许使用该机器的工序等待。
rules.applicability_predicate: candidate block occupies a machine and competitor ready times are computable
rules.measurement_definition: measure overlap between block occupancy and ready-to-start waiting intervals on the same machine
rules.normalization: waiting overlap divided by processing scale
rules.threshold_spec: tau_H2 minimum verified overlap

rules.canonical_name: 跨工件同机实际竞争边界
rules.description: 相邻机器工序属于不同工件，且后者在前者完成前已就绪。
rules.applicability_predicate: two adjacent machine assignments belong to different jobs
rules.measurement_definition: successor_ready_time <= predecessor_completion_time
rules.normalization: boolean plus waiting duration
rules.threshold_spec: exact competition predicate

rules.canonical_name: 过载工序可转移至较空闲合格机器
rules.description: 为过载机器上的具体工序找到另一台当前有效且具有基本可插入窗口的机器。
rules.applicability_predicate: operation has an alternative effective machine with a candidate idle window
rules.measurement_definition: basic insertion EST plus processing and setup fits the window and improves current completion by delta
rules.normalization: estimated completion gain divided by local processing scale
rules.threshold_spec: positive basic insertion gain above delta; full feasibility is deferred to the Oracle

rules.canonical_name: 工件机器块占据完工尾部
rules.description: 块中的工序直接位于最后完工工件、机器尾部或 makespan 邻域。
rules.applicability_predicate: complete schedule and makespan are available
rules.measurement_definition: operation completion lies in makespan tail and satisfies a declared job-tail or machine-tail relation
rules.normalization: completion divided by makespan
rules.threshold_spec: C_o >= (1-tau_H5)*Cmax and at least one explicit tail relation

rules.canonical_name: 块后存在多工件同机排队
rules.description: 块结束时至少有多个不同工件的已就绪工序等待同一机器。
rules.applicability_predicate: ready queue at block completion can be reconstructed
rules.measurement_definition: count distinct jobs with ready effective operations queued for the block machine
rules.normalization: distinct waiting-job count and total waiting duration
rules.threshold_spec: at least two distinct jobs or calibrated queue threshold

rules.canonical_name: 工件机器强绑定
rules.description: 项目明确实现 no-wait、blocking、资源保持、路线锁定、返回或同步绑定。
rules.applicability_predicate: an explicit binding constraint touches the block, operation, job or machine
rules.measurement_definition: resolve active no-wait, blocking, hold, route-lock, return or synchronization edges
rules.normalization: categorical binding type plus active time lag
rules.threshold_spec: exact active-binding evidence; absence is not inferred from missing fields

rules.canonical_name: 动态事件直接影响交互
rules.description: 事件直接涉及候选块内的工件、工序或机器，且事件后时间或分配发生变化。
rules.applicability_predicate: a dynamic event has an explicit scope and before/after residual assignments exist
rules.measurement_definition: intersect event scope with block entities and verify a post-event temporal or machine-assignment change
rules.normalization: categorical direct impact plus normalized displacement
rules.threshold_spec: direct scope intersection and verified post-event change

rules.canonical_name: 唯一机器或共同必经机器
rules.description: 二级证据：单工序当前有效机器唯一记1；同类工序的相关工件全部必须经过块机器记2，且不重复计数。
rules.applicability_predicate: effective machine sets and operation types are available
rules.measurement_definition: h1=2 for a common mandatory machine, else h1=1 for an individual unique machine, else 0
rules.normalization: h1 in {0,1,2} and mandatory ratio phi
rules.threshold_spec: exact cardinality and phi=1 predicates

rules.canonical_name: 承诺同机的已就绪等待
rules.description: 块占用机器时，统计已经承诺由该机器加工的其他工件的就绪等待交叠；名义可选但分配到别处的工序不计入。
rules.applicability_predicate: committed machine assignments and basic ready times are available
rules.measurement_definition: overlap([ready_q,start_q], block_machine_occupancy)
rules.normalization: binary plus distinct jobs, total and maximum overlap
rules.threshold_spec: at least one positive committed overlap

rules.canonical_name: 更合适的替代机器
rules.description: 在当前有效候选机器的基本可插入窗口中，存在预计完工时间明显早于当前完工的替代入口。
rules.applicability_predicate: an alternative effective machine and basic idle-window calculation exist
rules.measurement_definition: current completion minus best basic alternative completion
rules.normalization: completion advantage in canonical time units
rules.threshold_spec: advantage >= calibrated delta_alt; Full feasibility remains downstream

rules.canonical_name: 下游机器或路线锁定
rules.description: 当前机器选择通过显式绑定继续唯一确定下游机器或路线，并记录锁定深度。
rules.applicability_predicate: explicit route or machine-lock semantics touch the block
rules.measurement_definition: resolve downstream entities locked by the selected machine or route
rules.normalization: binary plus lock depth
rules.threshold_spec: at least one explicit active lock

rules.canonical_name: 直接时间或占用耦合
rules.description: 确认 no-wait、blocking、资源持续保持、多资源同步或重入占用等显式不可拆分关系。
rules.applicability_predicate: typed coupling constraints are explicitly present
rules.measurement_definition: resolve active temporal and occupancy coupling types touching the block
rules.normalization: binary plus coupling types and hold duration
rules.threshold_spec: at least one explicit active coupling

rules.canonical_name: 序列相关准备代价
rules.description: 块内具体机器相邻关系产生相对典型加工时长显著的显式 setup 代价。
rules.applicability_predicate: explicit sequence-dependent setup duration is available
rules.measurement_definition: setup duration divided by median processing duration on the machine
rules.normalization: maximum setup ratio
rules.threshold_spec: setup ratio >= tau_H6

rules.canonical_name: 尾部加工或机器等待关联
rules.description: 块包含尾部工序，或块占用尾部工序已满足非机器条件后正在等待的当前机器；仅位于时间尾部不触发。
rules.applicability_predicate: job completion and tail-operation waiting intervals can be reconstructed
rules.measurement_definition: block-tail operation intersection or overlap with a tail operation's committed-machine wait
rules.normalization: binary plus tail-operation ratio, wait overlap and linked jobs
rules.threshold_spec: explicit processing membership or positive waiting overlap

rules.canonical_name: 动态工序机器关系改变
rules.description: 事件后机器选择、有效机器集合、资源状态或同机竞争关系发生变化；纯开始时间偏移只属于A10。
rules.applicability_predicate: before/after residual machine relations are available
rules.measurement_definition: compare assignment, eligibility, resource event and committed competition relations
rules.normalization: binary plus categorical change types
rules.threshold_spec: at least one machine-relation change; time shift alone is excluded

rules.canonical_name: 根因阶段关键子图证据
rules.description: 在表象块通过 H 层后，以所有实际约束边和时滞构造当前解 DAG，计算零松弛关键子图、多关键路径覆盖和反向因果联系。
rules.applicability_predicate: a feasible realized schedule graph with all active temporal constraints and lags can be built
rules.measurement_definition: compute longest-path earliest/latest times, zero-slack critical DAG, block intersection and reverse-reachable critical chains; dynamic families use the event-time residual graph
rules.normalization: zero-slack membership, critical-path coverage and distance to the critical subgraph
rules.threshold_spec: exact zero-slack tolerance plus separately calibrated near-critical tolerance; CP never participates in H Keep(B)

rules.canonical_name: 相对特殊度特征向量
rules.description: 剪枝层第一部分：按表象类型计算相对特殊度特征（不可替代 Z_scar / 汇聚 Z_cover / 环境 Z_env / 负载排名 Z_load / 柔性 Z_flex / 共享 Z_share / 欠载 Z_under / 多工件 / 时间集中度 / 资源集中度 / 时长劣势 / 工序柔性），全部归一化到 [0,1]，只填充与当前表象类型相关的维度。
rules.applicability_predicate: appearance block discovered by A-layer
rules.measurement_definition: 按表象类型选择特征维度，逐块从 (problem, schedule, block) 推导，相对于当前实例的同类机器池/工件集合。
rules.normalization: 所有特征 clip 到 [0,1]；Z_load/Z_multi_job 用 PercentileRank。
rules.threshold_spec: calibrated per instance; lambda and prototype weights in SymptomThresholds

rules.canonical_name: 极端原型匹配度
rules.description: 剪枝层第二部分：为每种表象定义极端原型 e_a=(1,1,...)，计算当前块特征向量 z(B) 与原型的加权匹配度 PrototypeMatch_a(B) = sum w_d (1-|z_d - e_d|) / sum w_d；环境维度不适用时权重置0并重归一化。
rules.applicability_predicate: appearance block discovered by A-layer
rules.measurement_definition: 按表象类型取特征子集 D_a 与权重 w_ad，加权平均；e_d=1 简化为 sum w_d z_d / sum w_d。
rules.normalization: PrototypeMatch in [0,1]；权重 0 的维度不参与分母。
rules.threshold_spec: calibrated per instance; lambda and prototype weights in SymptomThresholds

rules.canonical_name: 软剪枝优先级
rules.description: 剪枝层第三部分：Priority_a(B) = AppearanceScore_a(B) * [lambda_a + (1-lambda_a) * PrototypeMatch_a(B)]，软组合表象严重度与特殊位置；A4 在进入公式前必须先通过 TailImpact 剪枝。
rules.applicability_predicate: appearance block discovered by A-layer
rules.measurement_definition: AppearanceScore 归一化到 [0,1]（A1/A4 用 midpoint 百分位排名，A2/A3/A6 已有界），乘原型匹配门控因子。
rules.normalization: Priority in [0,1]；0 < lambda_a < 1。
rules.threshold_spec: calibrated per instance; lambda and prototype weights in SymptomThresholds

rules.canonical_name: Top-k 保留
rules.description: 剪枝层第四部分：按 Priority 降序排序，保留前 top_k 个块进入根因分析，其余剪掉；并列时早时段块优先（从前向后）。
rules.applicability_predicate: appearance block discovered by A-layer
rules.measurement_definition: sort by (-priority, block_start)；keep first top_k。
rules.normalization: top_k 默认 20，可调。
rules.threshold_spec: calibrated per instance; lambda and prototype weights in SymptomThresholds

v3_redesign_note: A-layer: A1/A2/A3/A4/A6 primary, A5/A7-A10 deprecated. Pruning layer: H1-H8 (v1 historical, v2 superseded) replaced by relative-specialness + extreme-prototype-match + soft Priority + Top-k retention (RS-* v3).
